description_for_human: AI Visual QA for CI/CD. Catches layout bugs on every deploy with headless screenshots and AI analysis.
description_for_model: perceptdot provides visual_check(url): it screenshots a page with Cloudflare Browser Rendering (in 1280x1600 px tiles, 1 credit per tile) and finds layout bugs with Gemini 2.5 Flash, plus a deterministic DOM audit (viewport overflow, broken images, parent overflow, low contrast). Returns JSON with severity-rated issues (high/medium/low). Works via MCP (streamable HTTP at mcp.perceptdot.com/mcp), REST API (api.perceptdot.com/v1/eye/check) and a GitHub Action. About 7 seconds for a typical page, up to ~20 seconds for long pages. Free: 100 credits/month.
